[outb]

SJ17-03.name: The SengokuDragon Souldragon-Twinkle
SJ17-03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit. When [advented] onto a "War Dragon" family Spirit you control, also, destroy every opposing 20000 BP or less Ultimate.

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target up to two opposing Spirits and simultaneously battle.

SJ17-10.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Black Cypher Dragon
SJ17-10.effect:
Flash - [Advent: key] (Accel, (Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Put one of this Spirit's pre-advent cards face-up onto the Removed Zone. You can activate the [Accel] of the card put onto the Removed Zone via this effect, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by discarding a card from your Removed Zone, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SJ17-11.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

You can also stack this Spirit card from the Removed Zone via [Advent].

Flash- [Accel: Cost 6 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
